purpose: Engineering-control test of whether the four independently selected GMOS-S spectra support a covariance-complete stellar kinematic profile through 16.0 arcsec (70.28 kpc), fixed by the third preidentified strong-lens image before any A2537 science array is read.
forbidden_inputs_at_freeze: A2537 science-array values or any continuum collapse
digitized values from a published A2537 velocity-dispersion panel
any gravity, mass, dark-matter, negative-gravity, void, or fitted residual
any post-pixel change to the 16.0-arcsec support, spatial bins, fit windows, bootstrap construction, or pass thresholds
relabeling A2537 as a non-disturbed pilot

software_environment.baseline_reduction_engine: DRAGONS 4.2.2 in the existing isolated Python 3.12 conda environment

bad_pixel_mask.selection: Archive GMOS-S EEV full-frame 2x2 three-amplifier BPM preceding the September 2008 science and matching the exact detector label.

detector_and_2d_reduction.bias: Overscan-correct and sigma-clipped-median combine the five same-night biases; never mix nights.
detector_and_2d_reduction.flat_arc: Process each mapped GCAL flat and CuAr arc individually; do not stack across central-wavelength settings.
detector_and_2d_reduction.science: Bias subtract, flat correct, mosaic, wavelength calibrate, distortion correct, propagate variance/DQ, and cosmic-ray flag every exposure independently.
detector_and_2d_reduction.sky_fit: Per-wavelength inverse-variance linear spatial model with three iterations of 4-sigma clipping.
detector_and_2d_reduction.combination: Register each exposure to its reconstructed sky BCG center, resample once, inverse-variance combine with 4-sigma clipping, and retain all four individual calibrated frames.

calibration_acceptance.failure_policy: Any failed threshold ends the engineering control. Do not remove frames or change apertures, windows, mappings, or thresholds after a science pixel, velocity, or dispersion is seen.

pointing_geometry.registration_rule: Fit the continuum center independently in detector coordinates, transform through the calibrated WCS to a sky BCG coordinate, then test the four reconstructed sky coordinates. Intentional along-slit pointing steps must not be treated as centroid disagreement.

continuum_center_fit.model: Independent Moffat center, alpha, beta, nonnegative amplitude, and constant per exposure; infer one sky coordinate from each fit.

spatial_extraction.signed_bin_retention: All nine signed bins, including both 11.0-16.0 arcsec outer bins, must pass S/N and valid-pixel gates.
spatial_extraction.symmetrized_output: After side-consistency gates, generalized least-squares combine four opposite-side pairs plus the central bin into five radial bins with a full 5x5 covariance.

stellar_kinematic_fit.lsf: Measure an arc-line FWHM spline in 200-Angstrom bins and forward-convolve XSL templates; never apply a negative correction.
fixed_masks: all nonzero DQ and nonpositive variance pixels
chip-gap and combined-coverage pixels with fewer than three exposures
5577 Angstrom sky line plus or minus 8 Angstrom
pixels exceeding a local 21-pixel variance median by 6 robust sigma

covariance_protocol.joint_resampling: Resample four calibrated exposures with replacement; use shared eight-pixel spectral Rademacher blocks across all signed bins; perturb reconstructed sky center, wavelength solution, and LSF from their pre-kinematic covariances.

stage_outcomes.outcome: All 21 raw/calibration/BPM files are recognized without header edits under exact DRAGONS 4.2.2/pPXF 9.4.8.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Every recognition, version, and BPM checksum gate passes.

stage_outcomes.outcome: Four independent calibrated 2-D spectra plus three frozen sky variants, registered through reconstructed sky BCG coordinates.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: All bias, flat, wavelength, reconstructed-center, coverage, and sky thresholds pass.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Any numerical threshold fails; do not remove an exposure or ignore the intentional pointing steps.

stage_outcomes.outcome: Nine signed bins through 16.0 arcsec, five radial bins, a 200-replicate covariance, and the frozen 27-run systematic grid.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Both outer bins and every uncertainty, side-consistency, covariance, and <=10% systematic-shift gate pass, leaving the three preidentified images from two families inside accepted support.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Any outer bin, stability gate, or 15.886-arcsec overlap condition fails; preserve A2537 as a failed disturbed control. Passing establishes pipeline feasibility only and never supplies a non-disturbed science pilot.
